last_verdict: FALSIFIES — Frozen decision_rule triggers FALSIFIES on multiple clauses: C1 fails (60/240 byte-identical CDN decompression, 0.25 — only GZIP-OUTER with client Accept-Encoding containing gzip passes all 60 cells; all other 180 fail), C2 fails (header match 60/240, byte passthrough 40/240, silent HTML gzip re-encode under unchanged header, fixed-order streaming fails on all 180 transformed deliveries), C4 fails (5/15 identity byte-identical, CDN gzip-compresses JSON/HTML identity text when client accepts gzip — benign and reversible, BINARY identity 5/5 passthrough). C3 passes as consecutive-serve stability (6/6 triplets byte-stable across 1s reps; cf-cache-status DYNAMIC on all 273 CDN responses, no HIT observed — stale-cache serving not exercised). Positive control B-LOCALHOST-DIRECT passes 240/240 with 240/240 raw-byte passthrough, 0 transport errors — environment valid, CDN inferences licensed. All five baselines B-CDN-RAW-PASSTHROUGH (0/60), B-CDN-GZIP-ONLY (30/60), B-CDN-BROTLI-ONLY (0/60), B-CDN-IDENTITY (5/15), B-LOCALHOST-DIRECT (240/240) are correctly measured. Audit PASS confirms all recomputed metrics match producer. The diagnosed failure mode is CDN Accept-Encoding negotiation — Cloudflare transparently decodes/re-encodes origin Content-Encoding based on client advertisement: (1) gunzip when client omits gzip (GZIP-OUTER+AE br/none → inner-brotli bytes with CE absent), (2) always de-brotli (BROTLI-OUTER never byte-identical, text re-gzipped when client accepts gzip, octet-stream served as decoded inner-gzip with CE absent), (3) silent re-encode under unchanged header (HTML GZIP-OUTER+AE gzip → CE gzip but different bytes, still valid gzip of same inner content), (4) identity text gzip-compressed by CDN when client accepts gzip (CE gzip, reversible). No chunk-size effect (8192 vs 32 agree on all 48 cells). Key diagnostic: encoding-agnostic iterative full-body decode (try brotli → try gzip until identity) recovers ground truth on 24/24 JSON/HTML forensic CDN deliveries — the failure is in the fixed origin-order framing assumption, not byte corruption. However, encoding-agnostic decode was NOT a frozen condition; it is a hypothesis for the next experiment, not an established result. Claim ceiling bounded to: Cloudflare free tier, single edge (sjc01), 10KB nominal, depth 2, gzip L1 / brotli q4, sequential requests, no cache HIT observed. C-MEAS-VALID remains EXPERIMENTAL and is blocked from Product Core promotion pending encoding-agnostic decompression validated through the same CDN protocol.
